status: Codex engineering correction to revision interpretation; original model revision preserved
termination_reason: The initial new solve and historical corrected-A diagnostic use different schedules and different optimization formulations; their disagreement values cannot be treated as a controlled causal comparison proving a refinement gain or slow grid convergence. Both new solves use substeps=2. Tiny negative reported slacks (about -1e-8) are numerical bound relaxation, not negative physical gaps. Original acceptance uses unsoftened metrics. A coefficient of 0.001 is a weighted search tradeoff and does not guarantee zero slacks or improved physical speed margin. Lack of a preference among feasible slack-zero points does not establish global optimality, a unique cause for the returned margin, or exclusion of the other supported search choices. Candidate selection prioritizes hard validity, original task gaps, then effort; the report retains both selected and raw-returned vectors. These corrections prescribe no model revision or stopping decision.
